## Happy Planet Index Explorer

Use the country menu to select a country and the measure menu to explore the Happy Planet Index, life expectancy, life satisfaction, or ecological footprint. The year-range slider can be used to focus on a specific time period, and the Data Table tab shows the values used in the visualization.

  width="100%"

</iframe>

## mtcars Explorer

Use the X-axis menu to choose horsepower, weight, or displacement. The cylinder checkboxes can be used to include or exclude cars with 4, 6, or 8 cylinders, and the plot, summary, and table update together.

  src="https://insanglee.shinyapps.io/mtcars_app/"
